label: POST-HOC re-analysis. Nothing here was frozen before the original runs. Original verdicts are quoted verbatim in original_verdict_verbatim fields and are never modified.
reads_only: experiments/*/results/*.json and the frozen scenario JSON next to them (for original bootstrap seeds). Writes only analysis/reanalysis/reanalysis-v1.json.

reproduction_summary.method: same percentile bootstrap of the median, numpy default_rng(seed + offset), 10000 draws, 90% level; compared to stored lower/median/upper with relative tolerance 1e-9

E001_screen_v1.scope: E001 virtual screening v1: 3 policies, one scenario, n=1, all modeled
E001_screen_v1.energy_formula: base_power_total x elapsed + per_gpu_power x summed accelerator-seconds (inferred from scenario fields; identity holds to the error shown)
E001_screen_v1.bytes_formula: sync_cycles x gradient_bytes x links (inferred; identity holds to the error shown)
E001_screen_v1.reading: Bytes follow from the number of sync cycles, energy from time and busy time, and the learning ratio from a declared sensitivity. All three are the scenario's inputs read back out. The only content is that the simulator is internally consistent.

E001_recovery_v2.scope: E001 recovery mechanics v2: one deterministic virtual trace, 4 policies, n=1, no uncertainty exists
E001_recovery_v2.reading: Energy is a linear function of attempted FLOPs (plus a negligible network term) because the scenario says so, so 'adaptive uses less energy' is the same fact as 'adaptive loses less work'. Lost work follows from checkpoint interval (1 step vs 2). Times follow from fixed durations in the scenario. Learning progress is one declared prior for every policy.

E001_LC1.scope: LC1 survivor-continuation calibration, from-scratch 256-tick runs, 6 held-out strata (n=6)

post_hoc_nll_adaptive_minus_fixed_interr.name: nll_final_diff
post_hoc_nll_adaptive_minus_fixed_interr.note: adaptive finishes all 256 canonical ticks, fixed does not (horizon is fixed in opportunity ticks)

post_hoc_nll_adaptive_at_equal_attempted.name: nll_equal_attempted_compute
post_hoc_nll_adaptive_at_equal_attempted.note: adaptive curve linearly interpolated (8 points, every 32 ticks) at fixed's attempted tokens; coarse, post-hoc

post_hoc_energy_ratio_idle_subtracted_sa.name: energy_ratio_interrupted
post_hoc_energy_ratio_idle_subtracted_sa.note: from-scratch regime where adaptive does 12.5% more attempted work; sampled 100 ms NVML idle-subtracted; context only

E001_LC2.scope: LC2 quality-to-target protocol stages; no held-out policy comparison exists (n=0 pairs)
E001_LC2.reading: At the late-stage plateau the 256-tick drift in held-out NLL is about as large as tick-to-tick evaluation wobble, so a first-crossing time is set by noise. The protocol check that caught this is a valid check.

E001_LC3.scope: LC3 equal-canonical-work, 6 held-out fixed/adaptive pairs (n=6) on one RTX 3060 Laptop GPU

energy_ratio_raw_sampled_post_hoc.name: energy_ratio_raw_sampled_post_hoc
energy_ratio_raw_sampled_post_hoc.note: raw sampled energy only covers sampled spans; post-hoc, not a frozen metric

physical_run_seconds_ratio.name: physical_run_seconds_ratio
physical_run_seconds_ratio.note: whole run incl. evaluation and idle outage ticks

mean_raw_power_w_adaptive.name: mean_raw_power_w_adaptive
mean_raw_power_w_adaptive.note: raw sampled J / metered active s

mean_raw_power_w_fixed.name: mean_raw_power_w_fixed
mean_raw_power_w_fixed.note: raw sampled J / metered active s

calibration_identical_learning_pairs.note: same weights, same tokens; only checkpoint cadence differs. Ratios below 1 here show the sampled-energy noise exceeds the effect.

energy_resolution.inference: meter stops and restarts every evaluation_interval_ticks (read from e001_lc3_equal_work.py loop); no thermal pause occurred (all thermal_pause_seconds are 0)
energy_resolution.sampler_spacing_source: e001_learning_calibration._PowerSampler.sample waits 0.1 s between instantaneous NVML reads (source read, not persisted in artifact)
energy_resolution.idle_estimate_inferred_window_s: 20 reads x 50 ms = about 1 s, i.e. about 2 meter updates at the 0.495 s update period
energy_resolution.clamp: per-segment max(0, raw - idle*span): negative segments are set to 0 (read from source), which biases idle-subtracted energy upward when training power is near idle

energy_gate_power.method: Monte Carlo 20000 sims, per-pair log ratio ~ Normal(log true, observed sd), pass = t-interval upper bound <= bar; seeded

nll_noninferiority_robustness.margin_rule_text: greater than twice the untouched LC2 C1/C2 fixed-control endpoint span, rounded upward before LC3 evaluation
nll_noninferiority_robustness.note: adaptive-minus-fixed is positive in 6 of 6 pairs; the cost is small but systematic, so it is a real tiny penalty rather than noise

bridge_modeled.plain_boundary: Modeled repeated-trace sensitivity conditioned on the observed LC3 equal-canonical-work endpoint. Not measured datacenter performance.

E002_PW1.scope: PW1 checkpoint-power 2x2 factorial, 32 runs, 6 eval blocks (n=6), 20 ms polling of instantaneous NVML power
E002_PW1.reading: The artifact marks itself measurement_invalid. Its energy ratios (0.79 and 0.82) differ from LC3 (1.07) and PW2 (1.02) for the same contrast, which sizes the instantaneous-meter noise.

E002_PW2.scope: PW2 checkpoint-energy 2x2 factorial, same design as PW1, NVML cumulative energy counter, 6 eval blocks (n=6)

post_hoc_raw_energy_ratio_D_over_C.name: raw_D_over_C
post_hoc_raw_energy_ratio_D_over_C.note: cost of dense vs sparse checkpoints under continuation

post_hoc_idle_subtracted_ratio_D_over_A.name: idle_sub_D_over_A
post_hoc_idle_subtracted_ratio_D_over_A.note: uses idle_subtracted_energy_j_sensitivity; energy above idle is only 21-41 J per run

mechanism_attribution.checkpoint_related_group_definition: merge + snapshot + restore + rejoin-state-transfer + post-rejoin-sync (replay compute is NOT in the group, from scenario estimands)
mechanism_attribution.interaction_definition: (D - C) - (B - A) per canonical token; A sparse-restart, B dense-restart, C sparse-continue, D dense-continue
mechanism_attribution.plain: Under restart, dense checkpoints save replay work; under continuation there is no replay, so dense checkpoints are pure cost. The interaction compares those two, so replay compute (a saving under restart) is the largest single term. Snapshot writing is the next largest.

penalty_removed_fraction_diagnostics.reading: A 'fraction removed' above 1 is not a physical fraction. The denominator (D - A) is a few joules out of ~160 J, so the ratio is unstable. The gate (median >= 0.5) cannot discriminate.

measurement.label_warning: In PW2 the field named idle_subtracted_gpu_board_energy_j holds RAW cumulative energy (max abs diff vs raw_run_energy_j above). The primary, salvage ratio and LC3-corner ratio are therefore on raw energy; the LC3 bar of 1.05 was set on idle-subtracted energy.

E001_SC1.scope: SC1 observable semantic-slack controller: 4 calibration + 6 held-out stress families, ONE seed per family and policy (n=6; regret n=4); learning is measured, bytes and time are modeled

adaptive_normalized_oracle_regret.name: regret
adaptive_normalized_oracle_regret.note: n=4 families; the other two have no valid hindsight schedule

payload_gate_arithmetic.reading: Every action available to the controller costs at least as many bytes per two-site tick as periodic_local (the comparator). Adaptive can at best equal it (ratio 1.0). A 0.20 bound would need a 5x sparser action than exists (about one full-state average every 40 ticks instead of every 8). Arithmetically unreachable under the frozen action set. Even periodic_local itself is only 0.375 of synchronous bytes, so the original 10x-fewer-bytes hypothesis is also out of reach of every available action.

completion_gate_arithmetic.learning_valid_rule: final NLL <= synchronous_restart NLL + 0.01 (the oracle's own constraint in the scenario)
completion_gate_arithmetic.reading: Periodic_local was the calibration winner on time. On the six held-out families no learning-valid policy, including the hindsight envelope, is 10 percent faster than it in any family. No whole-policy schedule, including the hindsight envelope, meets a 0.90 bound while staying learning-valid, so the bound could not be met in these six families.

abstentions.reading: Abstentions occurred only on site_a_compute_rate_factor (0.75, 0.65, 0.70 vs a calibration floor of 0.80), in the same ticks where one site was down. In those ticks the controller takes exact_forward_recovery whether it abstains or not, so abstention changed no action.

adverse_summary.adaptive_modes_in_failures_note: In E3 (96 ticks) and E6 (216 ticks) the controller's medium-bandwidth/imbalance rule picks delayed_one_step, which calibration had already shown to be the worst-NLL policy (+0.044 to +0.051 vs synchronous in all 10 families, see post_hoc_delayed_minus_sync_nll_all_10).

periodic_local_vs_sync.mechanism_note: Same tokens, same optimizer, same LR. Periodic local averages model AND AdamW state every 8 ticks; synchronous takes one AdamW step on the union of both quotas every tick. A consistent lower NLL (10 of 10) is what weight/iterate averaging at a constant-LR plateau would give, but it could also come from per-replica clipping or Adam-moment effects. No control arm in the artifact separates these.

modeled_time_basis.note: Completion seconds use one frozen post-warm microbenchmark scaled by scenario rates plus bytes/bandwidth; they are modeled, not measured.

E002_rack_dephasing_v3.status: no result exists; nothing to re-adjudicate
